name: Eating Animals
overview: In the beginning, God provided plants and fruits for human sustenance, as seen in Genesis 1:29-30, where both humans and animals were given vegetation for food. However, after the flood, God expanded this provision to include all living creatures as food for mankind, as stated in Genesis 9:3. The Mosaic Law further clarified which animals were permissible to eat, demonstrating God's ongoing guidance for His people regarding dietary practices (Leviticus 11:1-2). These instructions reflect God's sovereign authority over creation and His provision for human needs within a framework of holiness.
